> Eod · 2026-09-15

Source: `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-15.txt`

Two reports share this date. The Pipeliners one covers Sep 14 to 15; the Summit one is headed "Monday" in the file (Sep 15 was a Tuesday, so it may describe the Monday 9/14 work).

# Pipeliners
File: `Pipeliners\EOD Report 2026-09-15.txt`. See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Baseline locked for the Oct 9 review (Aug 14 to Sep 10): 36 non-brand Google clicks, 63 GBP actions, 6 GA4 leads, 104 pages indexed. Check-ins: Buckeye 9/16 and 9/30, page reads 9/24 and 10/22, baseline 10/9.
- Sitemap: removed 5 noindex URLs (126 to 121); removed 2 dead sitemaps from GSC and re-submitted `sitemap_index.xml` (Success). Requested indexing on 3 pages; /repair-sewer-line-without-digging/ and /slab-leaks-phoenix/ confirmed indexed.
- 2026 SEO research (Google sources, Whitespark 2026): primary GBP category is the top map-pack factor, "open at time of search" now #5, listed GBP services rose sharply; llms.txt does nothing for AI Overviews per Google.
- GBP audit: 12 of 23 services not offered, Hydro Jetting missing, pipe bursting in description, 122 reviews at 4.99 but none since Jul 5, last post Jul 7, http link.
- Built a "Pipeliners Search Plan" dashboard (18 steps) and a "Pipeliners Website Pages" tracker artifact (110 pages: all 37 local pages indexed, 33 of 53 blogs indexed).
- Published "Fall Sewer Line Maintenance" at /sewer-line-maintenance/ (post 18123, author Jake Shaker, about 1,480 words, FAQ schema, [Higgsfield](lib:brain-higgsfield) image). Two thin 2025 posts merged into it with 301s via a new redirect mu-plugin.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
File: `Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-15.txt`. See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Rank Math tracker for all 200 pages (176 indexed; only 4 fully set up).
- New titles, keywords and descriptions on 29 indexed pages (water heater, garbage disposal and water pressure city pages, 2 service pages, 10 blog posts), after approval.
- Trimmed keyword boxes on 92 pages (removed brand, other pages' keywords, gas line and pool leak detection).
- Rewrote meta descriptions on 122 pages, dropping unbacked claims ("certified plumbers", "same-day service").
- Fully optimized indexed pages went from 4 to 78. Logged in `Summit-AZ-SEO-Change-Log.csv`.

# Follow-ups
- Pipeliners: Kim to request indexing for /sewer-line-maintenance/; add a link from the tree roots post (manual Elementor edit); Scott to confirm the real GBP service list and approve or reject "free estimate" and "20-year warranty" lines; Kim's OK needed for https GBP link, removing 122 hidden homepage links, locking 1,234 OTTO suggestions, and 4 city titles.
- Summit: fix 6 pipe-lining pages with wrong city; homepage meta (Scott); Service Areas title (approval); optional title trims; review rankings 10/2.
